projectName: St. Michael's Higher Secondary School website refresh
description: Improve the existing React website for St. Michael's Higher Secondary School, Umsning, with a fully responsive layout, clear navigation, and appropriate use of the images already present in public/assets.

questions.question: Which language should the website use?
questions.rationale: The existing website is a React and TypeScript project.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Keep the existing typed React implementation.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the website use?
questions.rationale: The workspace already contains a React/Vite website.

options.label: React with Vite
options.description: Continue with the existing frontend stack.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a different framework or approach.

questions.question: What should the refresh prioritize? The initial understanding is a responsive school website with improved navigation and relevant photos from the existing public/assets folder. Add any design preferences or other changes here.
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive layout, accessible mobile navigation, and appropriate use of existing school photos.
questions.answer: Responsive layout, accessible mobile navigation, and appropriate use of existing school photos.
questions.rationale: The request asks for responsiveness, navigation, and use of attached images, but does not specify the preferred visual style or exact changes.

questions.question: Does the website need persistent data storage?
questions.rationale: The requested website refresh can use the existing frontend and local image assets without adding a datastore.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use the existing static website assets and frontend behavior.

options.label: Azure Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve website images and other uploaded media.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: No sign-in feature was requested for this public school website.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to access application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The website is publicly accessible without sign-in.
